title: Rav Chanin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Gittin 85b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.85b.6): “Rav Chanin — and some say Rav Chanin of Mechoza — said to Rav Ashi.” Hyman calls this a scribal error and proposes “Rav Nachman said to him,” as in [Kiddushin 6b](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.6b.5), identifying him as the later Rav Nachman, as explained in his entry.[^1]

notes.text: Kiddushin gives Rav Nachman and, alternatively, Rav Chanin of Mechoza. Hyman would read Nachman in Gittin. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1393&lang=en) makes the opposite editorial choice and proposes removing Nachman from Kiddushin.
